briefings.title: A quiet investor’s $10 billion bet on AI, chips, and defense
briefings.tldr: Alex Davis, founder of Dallas-based Disruptive, has launched a new $10 billion fund to concentrate massive growth-stage capital on roughly 10 elite "N of one" companies—such as Palantir, Groq, Databricks, and Shield AI—leveraging an active, relationship-heavy approach that includes executive-level storytelling, global business development, and hands-on operational leadership.
